examples.text: Over 40 percent of the poor people are children.
examples.translation: 贫困人口中有超过40%是儿童。
examples.speechText: Over 40 percent of the poor people are children.

examples.text: Many a member of the armed forces（force的复数形式） has given his life for our country.
examples.translation: 许多军人为我们的国家献出了生命。
examples.speechText: Many a member of the armed forces has given his life for our country.

examples.text: You are no longer forced to stay in school all day, and apart from your class time, you can organize your own time and place for studying.
examples.translation: 你不再被要求整天待在学校里；除了上课时间，你可以自行安排学习的时间和地点。
examples.speechText: You are no longer forced to stay in school all day, and apart from your class time, you can organize your own time and place for studying.

examples.text: The key, she says, has been to make herself approachable and her instruction personal.
examples.translation: 她说，关键是让自己平易近人，并且让自己的教导有个人特色。
examples.speechText: The key, she says, has been to make herself approachable and her instruction personal.

examples.text: Damiano says she usually waits seven nights.
examples.speechText: Damiano says she usually waits seven nights.

examples.text: Throughout this century, English has grown more and more important.
examples.translation: 在整个这个世纪里，英语变得越来越重要。
examples.speechText: Throughout this century, English has grown more and more important.

examples.text: You can also take a walk or listen to music.
examples.translation: 你也可以散散步或听听音乐。
examples.speechText: You can also take a walk or listen to music.

examples.text: There are two factors which determine an individual’s intelligence.
examples.translation: 有两个因素决定一个人的智力。
examples.speechText: There are two factors which determine an individual’s intelligence.

examples.text: That rising air spreads outward and sinks between 20 and 40 degrees north and south of the equator.
examples.translation: 上升的空气向外扩散，并在赤道南北纬20至40度之间下沉。
examples.speechText: That rising air spreads outward and sinks between 20 and 40 degrees north and south of the equator.

examples.text: We enjoy them while they are shut up in prison.
examples.translation: 我们欣赏它们而它们却被关在监狱里。
examples.speechText: We enjoy them while they are shut up in prison.

examples.text: In this age of equality, sameness between the sexes（sex的复数形式） is emphasized as if differences have to mean problems.
examples.translation: 在这个强调平等的时代，人们强调两性之间的相同之处，仿佛差异就一定意味着问题。
examples.speechText: In this age of equality, sameness between the sexes is emphasized as if differences have to mean problems.

examples.translation: 围棋兼具美感与挑战性。

examples.text: Do your part to prevent spreading bacteria.
examples.translation: 尽自己的一份力，防止细菌传播。
examples.speechText: Do your part to prevent spreading bacteria.

examples.text: Known as “Dr. Tatiana” to her students and online fan base, the professor performs physics tricks（trick的复数形式） with boundless energy and enthusiasm.
examples.translation: 这位教授被学生和网络粉丝称为“Tatiana博士”，她以无限的精力和热情，展示各种巧妙的物理演示。
examples.speechText: Known as “Dr. Tatiana” to her students and online fan base, the professor performs physics tricks with boundless energy and enthusiasm.

examples.text: Hitler attempted to change the pilots biologically to win the war.
examples.translation: 希特勒试图通过生物手段改造飞行员来赢得这场战争。
examples.speechText: Hitler attempted to change the pilots biologically to win the war.
